sensor-test-soil-moisture.title: Sensor Test: Soil Moisture
sensor-test-soil-moisture.help: Simulation only. Insert BOTH gold probe tips in the soil. Drag the bare watering can to overlap the pot; it tilts 45 degrees and waters automatically. Move it away to stop. Double-click the can to remove it. Double-click the pot to reset moisture to 0%. Water soaks in gradually; soil type affects soaking, retention and drainage. The bar in the pot bottom strip shows current moisture. The simulated display shows 0–100 moisture; LED 0 is red below 30%, green otherwise. Air is a dry reference (0%), not a calibrated hardware measurement. Choose Blocks or Python, then Run; Stop ends the program. No CJP, Dashboard or Sprites required.

sensor-test-temperature.title: Sensor Test: Temperature
sensor-test-temperature.help: Simulation only. Drag the metal probe into the hot/cold cups; use each gear to trim water temperature. The seven-segment shows degrees C; LED 0 turns red above 30 C, green otherwise. Choose Blocks or Python, then Run; Stop ends the test. No CJP, dashboard or sprite is required.

sensor-test-ultrasonic.title: Sensor Test: Ultrasonic
sensor-test-ultrasonic.help: Simulation only. Move the striped target from anywhere on its body. Aim the ultrasonic marker with the angle control. The seven-segment shows cm; LED 0 is red for a valid echo below 20 cm, green for farther targets, and blue for no echo (0). Target gear changes its size; 1 stage unit = 1 cm. Range 2–400 cm, 30-degree cone. Choose Blocks or Python, then Run; Stop ends the test. No CJP, dashboard or sprite is required.

zone-01.title: HW - Real Sensor and Light
zone-01.help: Requires: CJP and temperature sensor. Try warming the real temperature sensor. Above 30 C, RGB LED 0 turns red; otherwise green. Choose Blocks or Python, then Run. Press Stop to finish. Hardware outputs keep their last state after Stop.

zone-02.title: Sim - Simulated Sensor and Light
zone-02.help: No CJP required. Open Simulation and change temperature across 30 C. Simulated RGB LED 0 turns red above 30 C and green otherwise. Choose Blocks or Python, then Run. Press Stop to finish.

zone-03.title: Dash - Dashboard Control Desk
zone-03.help: No CJP required. Open Dashboard. Hold or tap Hold; Held follows the press and Taps counts clicks. Power controls Enabled; Level controls Reading. Choose Blocks or Python, then Run. Press Stop to finish.

zone-04.title: Sprite - Move the Bee
zone-04.help: No CJP required. Open Sprites or Open Stage, then focus the stage. Arrows move and bounce the Bee; hold Space to hide it, release to show it. Press the stage to enlarge it. Choose Blocks or Python, then Run. Press Stop to finish.

zone-05.title: HW + Sim - Real Meets Simulated
zone-05.help: Requires: CJP, temperature sensor and standalone seven-segment display. Open Simulation. Real temperature appears on the simulated seven-segment display. Change simulated distance: the real standalone display follows. Choose Blocks or Python, then Run. Press Stop to finish. Hardware outputs keep their last state after Stop.

zone-06.title: HW + Dash - Hardware Control Desk
zone-06.help: Requires: CJP and temperature sensor. Open Dashboard. Temperature and History show the real sensor. Enable Light and adjust Level: RGB LED 0 turns red above the selected temperature threshold, green below it; disabling Light turns it off. Choose Blocks or Python, then Run. Press Stop to finish. Hardware outputs keep their last state after Stop.

zone-07.title: HW + Sprite - Joystick Pilot
zone-07.help: Requires: CJP (built-in joystick). Move the real CJP joystick: the sprite follows. At the stage edge, real RGB LED 0 turns red; otherwise green. Choose Blocks or Python, then Run. Press Stop to finish. Hardware outputs keep their last state after Stop.

zone-08.title: Sim + Dash - Virtual Instrument Panel
zone-08.help: No CJP required. Change temperature in Simulation: Dashboard follows. Toggle Light in Dashboard: simulated RGB LED 0 turns green when enabled, off when disabled. Choose Blocks or Python, then Run. Press Stop to finish.

zone-09.title: Sim + Sprite - Temperature Balloon
zone-09.help: No CJP required. Change simulated temperature: Ball size and speech change (size clamps safely to 10-300%). Arrows move it. At the stage edge simulated RGB LED 0 turns red; otherwise green. Choose Blocks or Python, then Run. Press Stop to finish.

zone-10.title: Dash + Sprite - Sprite Control Desk
zone-10.help: No CJP required. Open Dashboard and Open Stage side by side. Hold Move to advance and bounce the Bee; Visible hides/shows it; Size resizes it; Position reports x. Choose Blocks or Python, then Run. Press Stop to finish.

zone-11.title: HW + Sim + Dash - Compare Real and Simulated
zone-11.help: Requires: CJP and temperature sensor. Change simulated temperature and warm the real sensor. Compare gauges and histories. Threshold independently makes each matching real/simulated RGB LED 0 red above it and green otherwise. Choose Blocks or Python, then Run. Press Stop to finish. Hardware outputs keep their last state after Stop.

zone-12.title: HW + Sim + Sprite - Two Worlds, One Sprite
zone-12.help: Requires: CJP and temperature sensor. Real temperature changes sprite size. Simulated distance maps 2-400 cm onto x=-200 to 200. Near either edge (abs(x)>=190), both RGB LEDs 0 turn red; otherwise green. Choose Blocks or Python, then Run. Press Stop to finish. Hardware outputs keep their last state after Stop.

zone-13.title: HW + Dash + Sprite - Joystick Mission Control
zone-13.help: Requires: CJP (built-in joystick). Open Dashboard and Open Stage. Move the real joystick; Speed controls each movement step. X/Y show position and Edge lights green at a boundary. Choose Blocks or Python, then Run. Press Stop to finish. Hardware outputs keep their last state after Stop.

zone-14.title: Sim + Dash + Sprite - Virtual Weather Station
zone-14.help: No CJP required. Change simulated temperature and Dashboard Threshold. Above the threshold, the sprite becomes a Cactus and says Hot; otherwise it becomes an Apple and says Comfortable. Dashboard shows reading, history and warning. Choose Blocks or Python, then Run. Press Stop to finish.

zone-15.title: HW + Sim + Dash + Sprite - Smart Greenhouse
zone-15.help: Requires: CJP and temperature sensor. Warm the real sensor or change simulated soil moisture. Set Max temperature and Min moisture in Dashboard. Too hot OR too dry makes both RGB LEDs 0 red, Warning green, and the Cactus large with Check greenhouse speech. Otherwise both RGB LEDs are green and it says Healthy. Choose Blocks or Python, then Run. Press Stop to finish. Hardware outputs keep their last state after Stop.

hello.title: Hello Python (no gadgets)
hello.help: No CJP required. Prints text and a calculation.

sim-dashboard.title: Pretend sensor → dashboard and LED
sim-dashboard.help: No CJP required. Adds a simulated temperature sensor. Change its slider in Simulation; view its gauge and graph in Dashboard. Press Stop to finish.

mixed.title: Real temperature → dashboard and pretend LED
mixed.help: Connect a CJP with a real temperature sensor. Open Dashboard for readings. The LED in Simulation becomes red above 30°C and blue otherwise.

cross-displays.title: Real and pretend readings → opposite displays
cross-displays.help: Connect CJP, real temperature sensor, and standalone seven-segment display. Adds a simulated ultrasonic sensor and seven-segment display. Real temperature appears on the simulated display; simulated distance on the real display.

blink.title: Blink a real CJP light
blink.help: Connect a CJP. Its RGB LED 0 blinks red. Press Stop to finish; Stop leaves the last hardware output unchanged.

temperature.title: Real temperature → display and dashboard
temperature.help: Connect a CJP, temperature sensor, and standalone seven-segment display. Open Dashboard to see the reading there too.

joystick.title: CJP joystick click → real light
joystick.help: Connect a CJP. Press the joystick button to light RGB LED 0 green; release to turn it off.

stage-keyboard.title: Sprites: arrow-key movement
stage-keyboard.help: No CJP needed. Run, then click/tap the stage. Hold arrow keys or the on-screen buttons. Stop ends the program.

stage-temperature.title: Sprites: simulated temperature
stage-temperature.help: No CJP needed. Adds a simulated temperature sensor. Run, then switch to Simulation to change its slider; return to Sprites to see size and speech change. Dashboard shows the same reading.

stage-joystick.title: Move Sprite with HW Joystick
stage-joystick.help: Connect a CJP first. Its joystick moves the sprite. No extra sensor needed. Stop or unplugging the CJP stops the program.

dashboard-controls.title: Dashboard: buttons, slider and LEDs
dashboard-controls.help: No CJP needed. Run and open Dashboard. Hold/tap the button, toggle Power and change Level. Green means True, red means False. Quick taps increment Tap count.

dashboard-sprite.title: Dashboard: control a sprite
dashboard-sprite.help: No CJP needed. Run, open Dashboard in a separate tab/window, then choose Sprites in the editor. Hold Move, toggle visibility and change Size. Returning focus to the editor releases Move.

demo-temperature-hw-sim.title: Temperature sensor: HW and SIM
demo-temperature-hw-sim.help: Requires: CJP, real temperature sensor and standalone seven-segment display. The real temperature is shown on the simulated seven-segment; the simulated temperature is shown on the real standalone seven-segment. On each CJP, the four internal square LEDs (12–15) show its own temperature: blue below 18 C, green from 18 to below 25 C, yellow from 25 to below 30 C, red at 30 C and above. Warm the real sensor or change simulated temperature independently. Dashboard gauges show both readings and two history graphs log the latest 200 samples each. Choose Blocks or Python, then Run. Press Stop to finish. Hardware outputs keep their last state after Stop.

demo-soil-sim-hw.title: Soil Moisture: SIM to HW
demo-soil-sim-hw.help: Requires: CJP and standalone seven-segment display; no real soil sensor. No real soil sensor is used. Insert both simulated probe tips into the soil pot and drag the watering can over it to change moisture. The real and simulated standalone seven-segment displays both show simulated moisture (%). Below 25%, the real CJP plays a short low C3 beep (about 131 Hz, 150 ms) each loop. At 25% and above there are no new beeps. Dashboard shows moisture and logs the latest 200 samples in a history graph. Choose Blocks or Python, then Run. Press Stop to finish. Hardware outputs keep their last state after Stop.

ai-person-detector.title: AI + Dash - Person Detector
ai-person-detector.help: No CJP required. Prepare the CPU detector, allow your camera, then press Take Picture on the Dashboard. Switch to AI to see detection boxes. First load is about 32 MB. No image leaves your browser. Stop releases the camera and AI worker. Choose Blocks or Python, then Run. Press Stop to finish.

ai-image-workbench.title: AI + Dashboard - Named Image Workbench
ai-image-workbench.help: No CJP required. Run, then use the Dashboard: choose/start a camera, name and capture a photo, or name/upload an existing image. Select Camera capture or Saved image; press Detect Objects separately. Edit Capture button title to rename the capture button. Results include a boxed image, summary and table. Named photos stay in this editor session only. Upload works with no camera. No CJP required. Choose Blocks or Python, then Run. Press Stop to finish.

ai-ocr-reader.title: AI + Dashboard - Read English Text
ai-ocr-reader.help: No CJP required. Five widgets only. Run, click Load sample, then Read Text. Or before Run, capture/upload your own image in AI > Image. Recognition runs locally with the English fast model. The selected image, recognized text, confidence and time appear on Dashboard. Stop releases the engines; source images are not saved in project files. Choose Blocks or Python, then Run. Press Stop to finish.

ai-voice-light.title: AI + Dashboard - Voice Controlled Light
ai-voice-light.help: No CJP required. Five widgets. Run, click Start listening, allow microphone access, then say red, green or off and pause. Only completed exact matches change the simulated dashboard light. Stop listening releases the microphone; editor Stop also unloads the model. First use loads the English speech model. Audio stays on the user device. If the browser suspends audio, open AI > Speech Recognition and click Enable Microphone Audio. Choose Blocks or Python, then Run. Press Stop to finish.

ai-speech-transcription.title: AI + Dashboard - English Speech to Text
ai-speech-transcription.help: No CJP required. Five widgets: Start, Stop, Clear, Transcript and Status. Run, click Start, allow microphone access and speak English. Pause between sentences. Completed phrases appear in Transcript. Stop finishes the last phrase and releases the microphone; Start resumes appending. Clear resets the text/current phrase. The small local model does not add punctuation automatically. If audio is suspended, open AI > Speech Recognition and click Enable Microphone Audio. Audio is not recorded or uploaded; transcript displayed on Dashboard can be saved with the project. Choose Blocks or Python, then Run. Press Stop to finish.

ai-text-to-speech.title: AI + Dashboard - Local Text to Speech
ai-text-to-speech.help: No CJP required. Five widgets: Text, Speed, Speak, Stop and Status. Run, edit the short message, set speed and click Speak. Only browser-reported local voices are allowed. No local voice means a clear unavailable message, without remote fallback or a new model. If blocked by the browser, open AI > Text to Speech > Enable Speech and click it. Speak starts playback without waiting; status updates until it finishes. Stop cancels speech. The dashboard text input supports short messages; use AI panel for up to 1,000 characters. Choose Blocks or Python, then Run. Press Stop to finish.

ai-local-text-assistant.title: AI + Dashboard - Small Local Text Assistant
ai-local-text-assistant.help: No CJP required. Five widgets: Question, Ask, Stop, Answer and Status. Run and click Ask. First use loads about 370 MB of model data; try a laptop/desktop with enough free memory. The answer streams into Answer. Stop releases the model and keeps partial text. Each question is independent. This small experimental model can make factual errors: verify answers. Text shown on Dashboard can be saved in the project; no question is sent to a server for processing. Choose Blocks or Python, then Run. Press Stop to finish.

ai-voice-question-answer.title: AI + Dashboard - Talk and Hear an AI Answer
ai-voice-question-answer.help: No CJP required. Five widgets: Talk, Stop, Your Question, AI Answer and Status. Run, click Talk, allow microphone access, ask one short English question, then pause. The microphone turns off before the local LLM generates and speaks its answer. Stop cancels every phase. If needed, open AI > Voice Q&A and click Enable Microphone Audio or Enable Speech. Requires an existing local system voice; no remote fallback. First use loads speech/LLM assets; allow a processing delay and use a laptop/desktop first. Each question is independent and the small LLM can be wrong. Displayed question/answer text can be saved with the project; audio is not recorded or uploaded. Choose Blocks or Python, then Run. Press Stop to finish.
